cohort: 63,844 singleton live births in Nigeria from the 2003, 2008, and 2013 Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys
finding: The early neonatal mortality rate slightly declined from 30.5 to 26.1 per 1000 live births between 2003 and 2013, with rural residence, male sex, small neonatal size, maternal age <20 years, cesarean section, and birth order ≥4 with a short birth interval (≤2 years) identified as significant predictors of early neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was a significant predictor of early neonatal mortality, with an attributable number of 6312 deaths (95% CI 4260 to 8521).
